# Changelog

## 0.1.0-alpha.3 — 2026-07-24

- Added typed State–Decision–Effect and Review Assurance dispatch, mappings, schemas, fixtures, OMP surfaces, migration guidance, and release qualification while preserving alpha.2 skill bytes and legacy interfaces.
- Corrected stale alpha.2 display metadata in the alpha.3 README and OMP extension.

## 0.1.0-alpha.2 — 2026-07-23

- Added BBK alpha.4 `ImplementationStructureContract` and `ExecutionSlice` support.
- Added structure/slice/review entrypoints, namespaced schemas, focused review, mappings, gates and fixtures.
- Added type-driven development guidance and planned-versus-actual materiality policy.
- Preserved alpha.1 preflight, resolver, gate, installer and authority behavior.

## 0.1.0-alpha.1 — 2026-07-23

- Added initial BBK TypeScript/JavaScript comprehensive-alpha profile.
- Added twelve skills, deterministic preflight, resolver, gate planner, installer and OMP extension.
- Adapted the user-supplied comprehensive-analysis skill to evidence-based TS/JS review and non-overlapping delegation.
- Added eight synthetic fixture families and reproducible package tooling.
